references.text: Moses repeats the requirement to walk in the Lord's ways and keep His commands in order to prosper.
The same exhortation to walk in the Lord's ways and keep His commands.
The promise of long days in the land is linked to obedience to God's commands.
Loving the Lord and walking in His ways leads to life and blessing in the land.
Obedience to the commandments gives strength and long days in the promised land.
Blessed are those who walk in the Lord's law and go in His ways.
Keeping the commandments brings long days and life in peace.
The prophet urges people to ask for the old paths and walk in the good way to find rest.
Obedience to the Lord's voice and commands leads to blessing and protection.
Jesus declares Himself as the way that leads to life.
